name: receipts
description: Milestones instead of tool walls, an estimate that learns and names its basis, and a receipt under every answer that claims done.

spike.title: Spike unfamiliar tasks
spike.description: When a task shape has fewer than 3 past samples and the plan has 3 or more steps, spawn one cheap subagent per task to guess minutes per step. Counts as half a sample.

cleanView.title: Clean view on start
cleanView.description: Start each session with tool rows collapsed to one dim line each. Milestone events always draw in full.
